tickets.title: Cloud Infrastructure
tickets.description:
Hey team, we need to kick off the cloud backend project to scale our infrastructure and improve API performance for upcoming integrations. AWS will be our backbone (using S3, EC2), and we'll secure APIs with OAuth for enhanced security. PostgreSQL will be integrated for reliable data storage, and we must optimize it for future growth.

This project is a high priority since it's crucial for supporting increased user traffic and ensuring a robust backend as we roll out new features. Let's aim to get this done ASAP.

comments.author: Alex J.
comments.body: Hey Mustafa, I've set up the initial AWS resources, but I need your input on the API security protocols. Do we need to include OAuth or is JWT sufficient for now?

comments.author: Jerome
comments.body: Great start! Let's go with OAuth for now since it's more robust for user authentication. Could you also check the cost estimation for scaling?

comments.author: Mustafa Saim
comments.body: I'd recommend using OAuth for scalability, especially if we're handling third-party integrations in the future.

comments.author: Jerome
comments.body: Any updates on the PostgreSQL integration? We might face scaling issues if we don't optimize early.

comments.author: Mustafa Saim
comments.body: Working on it. I've added a few optimisations for read-heavy queries. Will share a detailed performance report soon.
